title: Deeala near players apartment

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Hey, remember me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, remember me?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Right. So you live around here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. So you live around here?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You wish. I just wanted to... ask you something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You wish. I just wanted to... ask you something.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Cute. Look, I just wanted to ask you something real quick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cute. Look, I just wanted to ask you something real quick.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You're a business owner. Kinda.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a business owner. Kinda.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I mean you're not Corp, but you're doing okay. Your head is above water.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean you're not Corp, but you're doing okay. Your head is above water.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: How many arses do you have to kiss on the daily?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How many arses do you have to kiss on the daily?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I mean, there's no way around it, right? CorpSec. The regional community enforcers. The gangers that want protection money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, there's no way around it, right? CorpSec. The regional community enforcers. The gangers that want protection money.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Why though?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why though?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I really hope you do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really hope you do.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I know what I am. And when you say stuff like that, I know what you are too. Another cynic. Just what this city needs...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know what I am. And when you say stuff like that, I know what you are too. Another cynic. Just what this city needs...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'm no better. Sure, I spend all night calling Corpos soulless, whining fucks with mommy issues, but at the end of the day, that's what they want to hear. That's what they pay me for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm no better. Sure, I spend all night calling Corpos soulless, whining fucks with mommy issues, but at the end of the day, that's what they want to hear. That's what they pay me for.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'm a hypocrite. It doesn't matter what I call them. It doesn't matter how pathetic I think they are. They could still ruin my life in a second. They own me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a hypocrite. It doesn't matter what I call them. It doesn't matter how pathetic I think they are. They could still ruin my life in a second. They own me.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I guess I've seen you around. Seen you work long hours. You're kinda new, but you look tired already. Like you've already been here too long.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I've seen you around. Seen you work long hours. You're kinda new, but you look tired already. Like you've already been here too long.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Fucking SAME! Look, I don't normally dump my trauma on people like this. Especially not on some random food cart owner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking SAME! Look, I don't normally dump my trauma on people like this. Especially not on some random food cart owner.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Well, I hope that plan works out for you, Captain. And don't worry, this won't be a recurring thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I hope that plan works out for you, Captain. And don't worry, this won't be a recurring thing.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Mom. My mom told me that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mom. My mom told me that.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Medium. It was average. We'll do better next time. So, uh... See ya.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Medium. It was average. We'll do better next time. So, uh... See ya.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Right... Right, yeah. Cool chat. Later I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... Right, yeah. Cool chat. Later I guess.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You can't run a business without taking a knee to all of those assholes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can't run a business without taking a knee to all of those assholes.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: But, uh, my therapist says I need to talk to people outside work. So... Yeah.
